## [這是什麼]{.zh}[What this is]{.en}

::: {.zh}
`stat-skills-tutorials` 是給 jamovi 模組 `askLLM` 使用者的原創教程與提示詞庫，
教你怎麼跟諮詢型 AI（Module Guider / R code tutor）協作做統計分析，而不是教
統計方法或 R 語言本身——統計知識一律連到 psyteachr、lsj-book 等外部教材對應章節
（見「外部教材導讀」）。

本站分三層，對應 README 提到的三件事：

1. **[協作素養](literacy/01-what-the-llm-sees.qmd)**：有意識了解 AI 是協作者、
   清晰描述問題、設定明確判準，六課短文。
2. **[提示詞庫](prompts/index.qmd)**：情境化、可直接複製進 askLLM `question`
   欄的提示詞，附查核點與判準；每條有結構化 schema（見 `prompts/_schema.yaml`）。
3. **[生成結果查核](verify/workflow.qmd)**：AI 回覆不是自己說了算，要拿 jamovi
   介面、原始資料、研究設計去對——Module Guider 與 R code tutor 各有一套查核清單。
:::

::: {.en}
`stat-skills-tutorials` is an original tutorial and prompt library for users
of the jamovi module `askLLM`. It teaches you how to collaborate with a
consulting AI — the Module Guider or the R code tutor — on statistical
analysis. It does not teach statistics or R themselves; for that, every page
links out to the matching chapter in an external textbook such as psyteachr
or lsj-book (see [External Reading Map](external/reading-map.qmd)).

The site has three layers, matching the three things the README describes:

1. **[Collaboration literacy](literacy/01-what-the-llm-sees.qmd)**: six short
   lessons on treating the AI as a collaborator with awareness, describing
   your problem clearly, and setting explicit acceptance criteria.
2. **[Prompt library](prompts/index.qmd)**: scenario-based prompts you can
   paste directly into askLLM's `question` field, each with its own
   verification points and acceptance criteria and a structured schema (see
   `prompts/_schema.yaml`).
3. **[Verifying generated results](verify/workflow.qmd)**: an AI reply is
   never taken at face value — it is checked against your jamovi interface,
   your raw data, and your research design. The Module Guider and the R code
   tutor each have their own verification checklist.
:::

## [目前狀態]{.zh}[Current status]{.en}

::: {.zh}
本站正在 **Phase 0（骨架與可行性）**：目錄結構、提示詞 schema、3 條示範提示詞、
1 份查核清單已上線；6 課協作素養短文與完整查核清單仍是待撰寫的 placeholder。
詳細規劃見 repo 內的 `PROPOSAL.zh-TW.md`。
:::

::: {.en}
The site is currently in **Phase 0 (scaffolding and feasibility)**: the
directory structure, the prompt schema, three example prompts, and one
verification checklist are already live. The six collaboration-literacy
lessons and the remaining verification checklists are still placeholders
awaiting content. See `PROPOSAL.zh-TW.md` in the repo for the full roadmap.
:::
